top_jobs.title: Senior AI-Native Fullstack Engineer (m/f/d) - DevOps
top_jobs.description:
Job description

We are looking for a Senior AI-Native Fullstack Engineer with a DevOps focus to support multiple engineering projects across AI-powered applications, SaaS platforms, and cloud-native solutions. This is not a traditional DevOps-only role. The role combines application engineering with infrastructure ownership: building services, APIs, automation and internal tools, while also running cloud infrastructure, deployments, observability and production operations.
